idea: Monthly stock count cleanup for online shops with 200+ SKUs on two or more sales channels, flat monthly fee
claims: Shops oversell when counts drift between channels

evidence.note: owner A: oversold 14 orders in the spring sale, refunded all
owner B: counts drift every month, fixes them on Sunday nights
owner C: no issue, single warehouse, one channel
owner D: bookkeeper spends a day a month reconciling
owner D pays the bookkeeper about 300 a month, a third of it on stock
owner A booked a 45-minute screen share of the spreadsheet
owner B introduced a seller friend with the same problem
14 forum threads in 90 days titled with 'inventory count wrong' or similar
owner C: great idea, I would totally use it

failure_modes.risk: owners will not give store access to an outsider
failure_modes.test: ask 5 owners for read-only access this week

failure_modes.risk: an inventory app adds automatic sync and the pain goes away
failure_modes.fix: sell the monthly audit and the fix, not the sync

failure_modes.risk: one cleanup is enough, nobody renews

reward_note: 5 shops at a flat monthly fee covers the month; renewals are the open question
